newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Compaq NZ sales broke NZ$100 mln in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Compaq NZ sales broke NZ$100 mln in 1996.

text.p: Compaq Computer New Zealand said on Wednesday its sales over calendar 1996 came to NZ$105 million, up 11 percent on the previous year's and exceeding $100 million for the first time.
Compaq NZ said the performance reflected the trend towards PCs becoming the dominant platform for business computing.
While final figures were yet to be released, Compaq NZ was confident it had grown market share to over 14 percent from 12.5 percent a year earlier. -- Wellington Newsroom (64-4-4734746)
